title: DOS Zone
summary: DOS Zone is a browser-based platform that allows users to run classic DOS games and software directly in the browser without requiring local installation, leveraging WebAssembly and DOSBox emulation technology.
problem_solved: Enables instant access to vintage DOS software and games without complex setup or legacy hardware.
why_valuable: Preserves retro computing heritage and makes classic DOS games accessible to modern audiences through seamless browser-based emulation.
